title: Sanitarium
shortDescription: Investigate an abandoned sanitarium closed by order in 1952.
description:
The gates of Blackwood Sanitarium stand open. A corroded brass plaque says the institution was closed by order in 1952. Inside, a broken staircase leads to deserted wards, an operating theater, and the rooms where the staff left their records.

Search the building and piece together what happened to the patients. The notes describe a treatment that never should have gone ahead. The marks left on the walls suggest its consequences are still here.
author: Studio Null

reviews.author: horrorFan99
reviews.title: Genuinely unsettling
reviews.body: I had to stop playing at night. The atmosphere is so thick you can feel it. One of the best horror text adventures I've played.

reviews.author: interactive_fiction_nerd
reviews.title: Slow start, incredible payoff
reviews.body: Give it an hour before judging. The first chapter is setting up something deeply twisted, and when it all clicks, it's unforgettable.
